newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's HACTL Jan to May throughput up.
newsitem.headline: HK's HACTL Jan to May throughput up.

text.p: Airfreight throughput in Hong Kong stood at 641,360 tonnes between January and May this year, up 16.8 percent compared to the same period in 1996, the Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL) said on Wednesday.
This was despite a 50 percent fall in the total tonnage of durians handled during the period, it said in a statement.
Commenting on the overall rise in throughput, the company said it had been evenly distributed with "imports, exports and transhipments registering strong and sustained gains".
HACTL also said only 4,750 tonnes of durians were handled in April and May, down from 9,197 tonnes during the same period in 1996. It blamed the fall on sea transportation.
